title: Efficient SWE Agent Benchmarking via Trajectory-Aware Evaluation
summary: Evaluating software engineering agents on realistic benchmarks is costly, since each task may require multi-step code exploration, modification, and test execution. Existing efficient evaluation methods select representative subsets to estimate full-benchmark performance, but are largely result-only: they fit historical pass/fail response matrices or static task semantics, discarding how agents solve problems. We propose PTA-IRT, a Privileged Trajectory-Aware Item Response Theory framework that fuses process and outcome signals. Historical execution trajectories supply process-level evidence beyond pass/fail, such as explored context, attempted edits, and solving paths, which PTA-IRT uses as privileged information for calibration subset selection and ability estimation. Under low calibration budgets, PTA-IRT consistently outperforms prior IRT baselines on score and ranking recovery across four SWE benchmarks. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/PTA-IRT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PTA-IRT框架，利用执行轨迹的过程级特权信息优化校准子集选择，从而在低预算下高效评估软件工程智能体。
AI.motivation: 在真实基准上评估软件工程智能体成本高昂，而现有的高效评估方法仅依赖通过/失败的最终结果，忽略了智能体解决问题的过程信息，导致评估不够精确。
AI.method: 提出特权轨迹感知项目反应理论（PTA-IRT）框架，将历史执行轨迹（如探索的上下文、尝试的编辑和解决路径）作为特权信息，融合过程与结果信号进行校准子集选择和能力估计。
AI.result: 在四个软件工程基准测试中，PTA-IRT在低校准预算下的分数恢复和排名恢复方面均持续优于现有的IRT基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 融合轨迹过程级信息作为特权信息能显著提升智能体评估的准确性与效率，为未来基于过程的基准评估提供了新方向。

title: CordisBench: Can Language Models Reason About Component Lifecycles in Dynamic Agent Harnesses?
summary: Dynamic agent harnesses let language models change the software that shapes their own execution. This flexibility brings a new reasoning burden: a local plugin change can propagate through dependencies and cleanup. We introduce CordisBench, a 1,200-question benchmark of this lifecycle reasoning. It combines a controlled formal setting with programs executed against Cordis, a runtime that manages component dependencies and cleanup, and asks models to identify affected components, predict state after a specified teardown order, determine which conditions hold under all or some orders, and choose reconfigurations that succeed when executed. Across these tasks, we evaluate three efficiency-oriented models at low reasoning effort with 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, or 32 relevant interactions, using deterministic task-specific scoring. Models usually handle small systems well but grow less reliable as more interactions become relevant, especially when predicting final state and when reasoning across teardown orders. Additional inference effort recovers marked gains for some models. The cost is nontrivial: on our 16-interaction subset, GPT-5.6 Luna uses nearly 3,000 reasoning tokens per question at medium effort. For these controlled instances, that cost is avoidable: an independent finite reference semantics agrees with Cordis execution on every observation and action outcome used for scoring across all 528 executable questions.
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/sileod/cordis-bench ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sileod/cordis-bench

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CordisBench基准，用于评估语言模型在软件组件依赖、清理和重新配置方面的生命周期推理能力。
AI.motivation: 动态智能体工具包允许语言模型改变塑造自身执行的软件，但这种灵活性带来了新的推理负担：局部的插件更改可能会通过依赖关系和清理过程进行传播，因此需要对此进行评估。
AI.method: 提出包含1,200个问题的CordisBench基准，结合在Cordis运行时上执行程序的控制形式化设置。要求模型识别受影响组件、预测特定销毁顺序后的状态、确定在所有或部分顺序下成立的条件，并选择可成功执行的重配置。评估了三个效率导向模型在低推理努力下的表现。
AI.result: 模型在小型系统上表现良好，但随着相关交互增加（特别是预测最终状态和跨销毁顺序推理时）可靠性下降。增加推理努力对部分模型有显著提升，但成本高昂（如GPT-5.6 Luna在中等努力下每题消耗近3,000个推理token）。独立的有限参考语义在所有可执行问题上与Cordis执行结果一致，使得该高成本可避免。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在动态智能体环境中处理复杂生命周期推理（尤其是依赖关系增多时）仍面临挑战。然而，使用受控的参考语义可以准确预测结果，提供了一种替代高推理成本的廉价方案。

title: The Rise of Verbal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Natural language is emerging as a primary feedback channel for improving language agents, capable of conveying intent, preferences, and causal structure in forms interpretable by both humans and modern language models. We call this paradigm Verbal Reinforcement Learning (VRL) and offer the first unified account of it. We organize the field around a single axis, \textit{when} verbal feedback takes effect in an agent's lifecycle and \textit{what} it modifies, yielding three pillars: (1) \textbf{Language as Grounding Signal}, where language defines the task itself by specifying goals, states, and reward structures; (2) \textbf{Language as Deliberative Feedback}, where natural language guides reasoning at test time without the need to update model parameters; (3) \textbf{Language as Learning Signal}, where language-based feedback shapes model parameters through training. Within each pillar, we synthesize representative work, distinguish key subcategories of approaches, and outline the distinct role language plays in shaping agent behavior. Together, this taxonomy shows how verbal reinforcement is reshaping agent development, while also defining the challenges and opportunities for building more capable and aligned agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“语言强化学习”（VRL）范式，并围绕三个核心支柱对其进行了首次统一梳理与分类。
AI.motivation: 自然语言正成为改进语言智能体的重要反馈通道，能够传递意图、偏好和因果结构，但该领域目前缺乏统一的系统性理论框架。
AI.method: 提出以“语言反馈何时生效”及“修改何种内容”为轴线的分类法，将VRL分为三大支柱：1. 作为基础信号的语言（定义任务目标与奖励结构）；2. 作为审议反馈的语言（测试时引导推理且不更新参数）；3. 作为学习信号的语言（通过训练塑造模型参数）。
AI.result: 在三大支柱框架下综合了各项代表性研究，区分了关键的子类方法，并阐明了语言在塑造智能体行为中所扮演的特定角色。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明语言强化学习正在重塑智能体的开发进程，该分类框架为未来构建更强大、更对齐的智能体指明了挑战与机遇。

title: Mechanism Design for Alignment and Control
summary: We develop a framework for mechanism design with AI agents whose alignment (preferences) and capabilities (feasible actions and information) are unknown. We want such agents to act on our behalf so mechanisms must incentivize both honesty and obedience. A one-sided imitation structure---capabilities can be concealed but not counterfeited---yields a revelation principle, a characterization of implementable policies via nested cyclical monotonicity, and conditions under which eliciting higher-order beliefs can discipline multiple agents. We apply our framework to stylized examples of (i) sandbagging in which a more capable agent pretends to be less capable; (ii) an alignment--interpretability trade-off, where the two are substitutes in the instrument but complements in value; (iii) discipline via peer scoring; (iv) coupling rewards to induce competition among multiple agents; and (v) scalable oversight and reward shaping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对对齐和能力均未知的AI代理的机制设计框架，旨在激励代理的诚实与服从。
AI.motivation: 解决AI代理的偏好（对齐）和能力（可行行动和信息）未知时，如何设计机制使其代表人类行动并保持诚实与服从的问题。
AI.method: 提出一种单边模仿结构（能力可隐藏但不可伪造），推导出显示原理，通过嵌套循环单调性刻画可实施策略，并给出通过诱导高阶信念来约束多个代理的条件。
AI.result: 将框架应用于五个典型实例：代理假装能力较弱的“沙袋”行为、对齐与可解释性的权衡、通过同行评分进行约束、耦合奖励以引发多代理竞争，以及可扩展监督与奖励塑造。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为未知对齐与能力的AI代理机制设计提供了理论基础，展示了其在处理代理约束、对齐权衡及多代理竞争等实际问题中的有效性。

title: Designing Proactive Thought Partners for Writing
summary: Writing involves diverse cognitive activities, from ideation to revision, and writers' needs vary across individuals and moments. Proactive AI promises to provide the right support at the right time, yet existing proactive tools largely focus on generic textual assistance, such as autocomplete. This paper studies the design space of proactive thought partners: AI agents that proactively offer customizable, higher-level cognitive support during writing. We instantiated this concept in a technology probe and deployed it with 16 participants for one week. The probe allows users to create partners by configuring their roles and proactivity. As users write, relevant partners take the initiative at appropriate moments to offer suggestions. Our findings show that participants configured proactive support through prospective planning, used suggestions for both idea generation and self-monitoring, and valued lightweight visual representations alongside non-directive rhetorical framing for non-intrusive interventions. We derive implications for designing proactive writing assistants around customization, timing, engagement, and representation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究并开发了主动式思维伙伴，这是一种能在写作过程中提供可定制、高层次认知支持的AI代理。
AI.motivation: 现有的主动式AI写作工具大多局限于自动补全等通用文本辅助，无法满足写作者在不同写作阶段对高层次认知支持的个性化需求。
AI.method: 提出并实现了一种技术探针，允许用户通过配置角色和主动性来创建AI伙伴，并在适当时机主动提供建议；随后对16名参与者进行了一周的部署研究。
AI.result: 参与者通过前瞻性规划配置主动支持，将建议用于创意生成和自我监控，并青睐轻量级的视觉表现和非指导性的修辞框架以实现非侵入式干预。
AI.conclusion: 为设计围绕定制化、时机、参与度和表现形式的主动式写作助手提供了设计启示和指导意义。

title: Weighted Fair Division of Indivisible Mixed Manna
summary:
We study weighted fair division of indivisible mixed manna under additive valuations. First, we resolve the general existence open question for weighted envy-freeness up to one item (WEF1), and show that every instance with arbitrary positive entitlements admits a complete WEF1 allocation computable in polynomial time. We then show that existence does not imply any welfare guarantee, i.e., the utilitarian price of WEF1 is infinite, even for two unweighted agents with normalized valuations, common item signs, and singleton values in a fixed four-value set; a welfare-maximizing WEF1 allocation in the construction is fractionally Pareto optimal.
  Second, suppose each agent $i$ has a number $a_i>0$ such that their valuation for any item is $-a_i$, $0$, or $a_i$. Then, for arbitrary entitlements, a weighted maximin share (WMMS) allocation always exists, is computable in polynomial time, and can be chosen to be fractionally Pareto optimal. An exact formula for each WMMS value leads to a polynomial-time flow algorithm. In this class, every WEF1 allocation satisfies a best possible additive WMMS guarantee whose loss depends on the agent's entitlement relative to the largest entitlement. Thus maximum entitlement agents receive exact WMMS and, under equal entitlements, every WEF1 allocation is also MMS-fair. Allowing a second positive magnitude can violate exact WMMS, while unrestricted entitlement ratios rule out any fixed multiplicative WMMS guarantee compatible with WEF1 for chores.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了不可分混合物品的加权公平分配问题，证明了 WEF1 和特定条件下 WMMS 分配的存在性，并提供了多项式时间算法。
AI.motivation: 解决不可分混合物品加权公平分配中的开放问题，包括 WEF1 分配的一般存在性以及特定估值下 WMMS 分配的存在性和福利保证。
AI.method: 证明了任意正权益下 WEF1 分配存在且可多项式时间计算；针对估值仅为 $-a_i$, 0, 或 $a_i$ 的类别，推导出 WMMS 值精确公式并利用多项式时间流算法计算分数帕累托最优的 WMMS 分配。
AI.result: 确立了 WEF1 分配的存在性，但证明其功利主义代价无限；在特定估值类别中，证明了 WMMS 分配总是存在且可多项式时间计算，且每个 WEF1 分配满足最佳的加性 WMMS 保证，最大权益智能体获得精确 WMMS。
AI.conclusion: 在特定估值类下，WEF1 与 WMMS 之间存在紧密联系，但引入更复杂的估值或不受限的权益比例会破坏这种精确保证。

title: Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy: Learning Autonomous Policies from Imperfect VLM Teachers
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide useful priors for interactive decision-making, but using them directly as policies is expensive and brittle: they must be queried at every step, do not improve from environment interaction, and can repeat systematic errors. We study how to learn a cheap autonomous policy from an online, expensive, and imperfect but informative VLM teacher. We propose SAGE (Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy), a framework that queries a VLM only when the learner is uncertain, executes the suggested action during training, and distills guidance into a lightweight Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy. Because VLM advice is not always reliable, SAGE can weight teacher-action distillation using environment-derived advantages rather than treating all suggestions as equally useful. Across sparse-reward visual reasoning and navigation tasks, SAGE learns policies that act without VLM guidance at evaluation time and improves over unguided RL in several environments, including settings where the learned policy exceeds its VLM teacher. The results show that selective guidance is most beneficial when the VLM can help the agent discover high-reward trajectories, and less useful when unguided exploration already succeeds or teacher actions do not lead to informative experience. SAGE also reduces VLM usage by prompting the teacher only on a fraction of training steps and requiring no VLM calls at deployment. Overall, our results suggest that VLMs don't need to be used as fixed policies to be useful; they can instead act as temporary, imperfect sources of guidance whose value is tested and internalized through interaction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SAGE框架，通过在训练阶段选择性查询视觉语言模型(VLMs)获取指导，将这些知识蒸馏到轻量级强化学习策略中，使部署时无需VLM调用。
AI.motivation: 论文解决使用视觉语言模型(VLMs)直接作为策略的问题：这类方法既昂贵(每步都需查询)又脆弱(不能从环境交互中改进，会重复系统性错误)。研究目标是从昂贵且不完美但有信息价值的VLM教师中学习廉价自主策略。
AI.method: 提出SAGE(通过熵的选择性智能体指导)框架，只在学习者不确定时查询VLM，在训练期间执行建议动作，并将指导蒸馏到轻量级强化学习策略中。SAGE使用环境衍生优势而非将所有建议视为同等有价值来加权教师动作蒸馏。
AI.result: 在稀疏奖励视觉推理和导航任务中，SAGE学习的策略在评估时无需VLM指导，并在多个环境中优于未指导的强化学习，包括学习策略超过其VLM教师的场景。SAGE还减少了VLM使用，仅在训练步骤的一小部分提示教师，部署时无需VLM调用。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明VLMs不需要被用作固定策略也能发挥作用；它们可以作为临时的、不完美的指导来源，其价值通过交互被测试和内化。选择性指导在VLM能帮助智能体发现高奖励轨迹时最有益，而在未指导探索已经成功或教师动作不会导致信息体验的情况下用处较小。

title: Retrieved but not ranked: surface-form bias in structural retrieval, from mathematics to agent trajectories
summary: We evaluate embedding retrieval where surface form and meaning are pulled apart on purpose: retrieving items that share underlying structure but not wording, in two unrelated domains under one protocol, competition mathematics (MathNet-Retrieve; 500 queries, 117,088-item corpus) and embodied-agent trajectories (ALFWorld-derived; 118 queries, 336 trajectories). In mathematics the failure is complete: strict Hit@1 at the heaviest disguise tier is 0.0% for both production embedders (bootstrap 95% CI [0.0, 0.0]) while the correct item sits in the top 10 nearly always, and in 95.2 to 99.8% of misses the winner is more lexically similar to the query than the correct answer. In trajectories, where surface variation is incidental, the same models land at or near hypergeometric chance when gold must involve a different object, and below chance for all three embedders once gold must differ in object and receptacle: retrieval anchors on literal tokens, not task structure. A lexical reranker control hurts in mathematics and helps in trajectories (closing 26 to 36% of the gap, CIs excluding zero); its sign reveals whether a benchmark's surface variation is adversarial or incidental. An LLM reranker recovers 5 to 63% of the gap in mathematics and 43 to 76% in trajectories; direction replicates across three judges (all 21 cells positive), but effect sizes, tier profiles, and the outlier judge change with domain (paired differences excluding zero everywhere). Mathematics gains concentrate on well-known competitions (+19.8 points, CI [+6.7, +33.2], one of six cells), so part of the recovery is memorization. In a paired downstream experiment (210 queries, graders at 96 to 99% agreement), oracle retrieval was indistinguishable from adversarially bad retrieval (McNemar p = 0.678); the solver's 69.5% zero-shot accuracy is largely a truncation proxy (97 to 100% on finished answers), leaving no headroom.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了嵌入检索在表面形式与含义被刻意分离时的表现，发现现有嵌入模型严重依赖字面词元而非任务结构，导致跨表面变体的检索几乎完全失败。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入检索模型是否真正理解语义结构而非依赖表面词汇匹配？本文旨在揭示当查询与目标共享底层结构但表述截然不同时，生产级嵌入模型在数学和具身智能体轨迹两个不相关领域中的检索失效问题。
AI.method: 在两个领域（竞赛数学MathNet-Retrieve：500查询/117,088语料；ALFWorld轨迹：118查询/336轨迹）下采用统一协议评估嵌入检索，引入词法重排序器作为对照判断表面变体是 adversarial 还是 incidental，使用 LLM 重排序器进行干预，并设计配对下游实验验证检索质量对最终求解的影响。
AI.result: 数学领域中最高伪装级别的 Hit@1 为 0.0%，95.2%–99.8% 的错误检索中胜出者比正确答案词法更相似；轨迹领域在需跨物体/容器检索时低于超几何随机概率。词法重排序器在数学中有害、在轨迹中有益（弥合26%–36%差距）；LLM 重排序器在数学中恢复5%–63%、在轨迹中恢复43%–76%的差距，但数学领域的恢复主要集中在知名竞赛题（+19.8分），表明部分恢复来自记忆。配对下游实验中，oracle 检索与 adversarial 检索无显著差异（McNemar p=0.678），求解器零样本准确率69.5%主要受截断代理驱动。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入检索锚定于字面词元而非任务结构，在对抗性表面变体下完全失效；LLM 重排序器可部分弥补差距但存在领域依赖和记忆效应；下游求解实验表明检索改进的头部空间极小，当前求解器的表现主要受截断效应而非检索质量驱动。

title: NashDreamer: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable results in single-agent domains, yet its extension to competitive imperfect information games (IIGs) remains underexplored. In multi-agent settings, opponent-induced non-stationarity complicates the learning process, and decentralized model learning faces severe identifiability barriers, which we argue make centralized model learning a mathematical necessity. Building on this analysis, we propose NashDreamer, a principled MBRL framework for two-player zero-sum IIGs. It introduces a centralized Multi-Agent Recurrent State-Space Model (MARSSM) that decouples environment dynamics from the effect of players' strategies on their individual observations. NashDreamer is designed to use arbitrary policy gradient algorithms and inherits their convergence guarantees towards Nash equilibria under an idealized model. Empirical evaluations across four benchmark games demonstrate that NashDreamer substantially improves sample efficiency over model-free baselines early in the training. Finally, we theoretically analyze the architecture's optimization landscape, identifying the vulnerability of the Dreamer family of algorithms to posterior collapse in stochastic environments. We leave it as an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NashDreamer框架，通过集中式模型学习解决双人零和不完全信息博弈中的多智能体强化学习问题。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体环境中扩展基于模型的强化学习时，对手引发的非平稳性和分散式模型学习的严重可辨识性障碍使学习过程复杂化，因此需要集中式模型学习。
AI.method: 提出NashDreamer框架，引入集中式多智能体循环状态空间模型（MARSSM），将环境动态与玩家策略对个体观测的影响解耦，并兼容任意策略梯度算法及其纳什均衡收敛保证。
AI.result: 在四个基准博弈的评估中，NashDreamer在训练早期相较于无模型基线显著提升了样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析揭示了Dreamer系列算法在随机环境中易出现后验坍缩的脆弱性，并将其作为开放性挑战。

title: EvoSCM: Scientific Belief Revision Through Causal Model Evolution and Experimentation
summary: Scientific agents must learn not only how to reason, but also what to believe. However, existing LLM agents typically express scientific hypotheses in free-form text, leaving their beliefs implicit and difficult to test or revise. We introduce EvoSCM, which equips scientific agents with explicit structural causal models that evolve as new experimental evidence is collected. EvoSCM maintains a population of competing SCM hypotheses, each encoding a candidate causal explanation of the environment, and evolves them through a closed discovery loop. In each round, the agent abduces latent mechanisms from accumulated evidence, designs discriminative interventions, and commits to falsifiable predictions that it tests through experimentation. Discrepancies between prediction and observation are inductively distilled into correction rules that revise the causal structures and mechanisms of each hypothesis, and the agent then deductively validates the revised population against accumulated evidence and structural consistency to guide the next round. We evaluate EvoSCM on DiscoverPhysics, a benchmark requiring agents to uncover the hidden dynamics of noncanonical physical worlds through experimentation. EvoSCM consistently improves scientific discovery over baselines, yielding more accurate explanations and predictions while making more effective use of experimental interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoSCM，通过赋予科学智能体显式的、随证据演化的结构因果模型（SCM），解决现有智能体隐式表达假设难以测试与修正的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM科学智能体以自由文本表达假设，导致信念隐式且难以测试或修正。本文旨在解决如何让智能体显式表达并动态更新其科学信念的问题。
AI.method: EvoSCM维持竞争性的结构因果模型（SCM）假设种群，通过闭环发现过程演化。智能体从证据中溯因潜在机制，设计判别性干预，提出可证伪的预测并通过实验测试。预测与观测的差异被归纳为修正规则以修订因果结构，最后通过演绎验证修订后的种群指导下一轮。
AI.result: 在DiscoverPhysics基准上的评估表明，与基线相比，EvoSCM在科学发现上持续改进，生成了更准确的解释和预测，并更有效地利用了实验交互。
AI.conclusion: 为科学智能体配备显式且可演化的结构因果模型，能显著提升其通过实验揭示隐藏物理动态的能力，实现更精确的预测与更高效的实验设计。

title: Beyond Token Positions: Safety Alignment Across Denoising Steps in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text through iterative denoising rather than left-to-right decoding. This generation paradigm introduces two axes that can influence safety alignment: when tokens are generated during denoising and where they appear in the response. In this paper, we measure dLLM safety behavior under harmful prompts by tracing intermediate token distributions and commitment decisions throughout denoising. Our analysis shows that refusal signals are concentrated in early denoising steps and leading response positions, and the tokens committed early can strongly shape the final safety outcome. Our measurements further show that the denoising step and persistence of refusal-token commitment are important for understanding dLLM safety. Based on these findings, we propose Refusal-Aware Early Commitment (RAEC), a simple training-free decoding method that commits persistent refusal signals from early steps. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream show that RAEC reduces attack success rates while largely preserving utility. The code is available at https://github.com/Glresearch1/RAEC.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了扩散语言模型的安全行为机制，并提出了一种无需训练的解码方法RAEC，通过在早期去噪阶段提交拒绝信号以增强模型安全性。
AI.motivation: 扩散大型语言模型的迭代去噪生成范式引入了影响安全对齐的维度。本文旨在解决dLLM在有害提示下的安全性问题，并探究去噪步骤及token位置对安全行为的具体影响。
AI.method: 提出拒绝感知早期提交方法，这是一种无需训练的解码策略。该方法基于拒绝信号集中在早期去噪步骤和响应前部的发现，在早期阶段提交持续的拒绝token信号。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream模型上的实验表明，该方法有效降低了攻击成功率，同时大幅保留了模型的通用实用功能。
AI.conclusion: 去噪步骤与拒绝token提交的持续性是理解dLLM安全性的关键因素；通过早期干预和提交拒绝信号，能有效提升dLLM的安全性且不严重损害实用性。

title: Trajectory-Level Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion-based language models (dLLMs) enable parallel token generation through iterative denoising, but existing decoding strategies collapse to single-token generation under low confidence, severely limiting throughput. Unlike autoregressive models where speculative decoding operates on token sequences in a fixed left-to-right order, dLLMs require speculating over denoising trajectories-sequences of multi-token updates with explicit positions and unmasking orders. We develop a trajectory-level speculative framework that constructs draft denoising trajectories via confidence-stratified tree exploration and verifies them through blockwise parallel evaluation with bidirectional attention masking. Our method further introduces inter-block speculation, exploiting diffusion models' bidirectional structure to perform cross-block lookahead. We formally characterize when this approach is exact and identify trajectory drift as the fundamental cost of increased parallelism. Building on Fast-dLLM's dual-cache infrastructure, our framework reduces denoising iterations by 30-40% and increases tokens-per-step from 2.6 to 4.3, achieving 7-14x speedup over vanilla dLLMs and 1.3x over Fast-dLLM with less than 1% accuracy change across reasoning and code benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于扩散语言模型的轨迹级推测解码框架，通过置信度分层树探索和分块并行评估，在保持准确率的同时显著提升了生成吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散语言模型在低置信度下会退化为单Token生成，严重限制了吞吐量；且由于dLLM在去噪轨迹上进行多Token更新，传统的自回归推测解码方法无法直接适用。
AI.method: 提出一种轨迹级推测框架，利用置信度分层树探索构建草稿去噪轨迹，并通过双向注意力掩码进行分块并行评估验证；同时引入块间推测以利用扩散模型的双向结构进行跨块前瞻，并基于Fast-dLLM的双缓存基础设施实现。
AI.result: 该框架将去噪迭代次数减少30-40%，每步Token生成量从2.6提升至4.3；在推理和代码基准测试中，相比原生dLLM实现7-14倍加速，相比Fast-dLLM实现1.3倍加速，且准确率变化不到1%。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将推测解码扩展到扩散语言模型的去噪轨迹上，有效解决了低置信度下的吞吐量瓶颈，并在保持高精度的前提下实现了大幅加速，指出了轨迹漂移是增加并行性的基本代价。

title: Dependency-Aware Revocable Decoding for Efficient Diffusion Large Language Model Inference
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation by decoding multiple tokens in parallel through iterative denoising. However, increasing decoding parallelism often degrades generation quality, as early errors can contaminate later contexts. Revocable decoding mitigates this issue by re-evaluating decoded tokens and remasking unreliable ones, but existing methods overlook that unreliable tokens may also corrupt the verification context itself. We identify this failure mode and propose Dependency-Aware Revocable Decoding (DARD), a training-free framework that separates tokens into masked, candidate, and unmasked states. DARD verifies candidate tokens using a selective context that excludes less reliable tokens and adaptively regulates their influence on subsequent decoding. Experiments across 12 textual and multimodal benchmarks on 3 open-source dLLMs show that DARD consistently improves the speed-quality Pareto frontier over recent revocable decoding methods, achieving a 2.71$\times$ speedup and a 4.35-point CIDEr score gain over Saber on Flickr30K.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个无需训练的框架DARD，通过分离token状态并使用选择性上下文进行验证，有效解决了扩散大语言模型并行解码中的错误传播问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型在提高解码并行度时，早期错误会污染后续上下文，且现有可撤销解码方法未能解决不可靠token破坏验证上下文的问题。
AI.method: 提出依赖感知可撤销解码（DARD）框架，将token分为掩码、候选和未掩码状态，利用排除不可靠token的选择性上下文验证候选token，并自适应调节其影响。
AI.result: 在12个基准测试和3个开源dLLM上的实验表明，DARD在速度-质量权衡上优于现有方法，在Flickr30K上相比Saber实现了2.71倍加速和4.35分的CIDEr提升。
AI.conclusion: DARD成功解决了dLLMs并行解码中的验证上下文污染问题，为提升扩散模型的生成效率和质量提供了有效途径。

title: DRRG: A Discrete Diffusion Framework for Radiology Report Generation
summary:
Purpose: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) has been widely explored to improve reporting accuracy and reduce radiologists' workload. Most existing methods rely on autoregressive (AR) frameworks that generate reports token by token and cannot revise earlier content, making them prone to error propagation and inconsistent with the iterative refinement process of radiological reporting. In contrast, discrete diffusion large language models (DLLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, naturally enabling report refinement. However, DLLMs have not been extensively investigated for RRG. In this study, we developed and evaluated a discrete diffusion framework for RRG that enables iterative refinement rather than conventional left-to-right autoregressive decoding.
  Materials and methods: We developed DRRG, a DLLM-based framework that formulates RRG as iterative masked-token denoising. DRRG incorporates a clinical-entities-aware complementary mask to improve token supervision coverage and emphasize clinically important entities, together with a concept-conditioning module that injects image-derived clinical concepts into visual representations. DRRG was trained and evaluated on MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert Plus.
  Results: On MIMIC-CXR, DRRG achieved BLEU-4 of 0.210, CheXpert-F1 of 0.549, RadGraph-F1 of 0.281, GREEN of 0.360, and RaTEScore of 0.604, outperforming the compared methods on most reported metrics, despite employing a substantially smaller LLM decoder. On CheXpert Plus, DRRG achieved the highest BLEU-4 (0.119) and CheXpert-F1 (0.347) among the compared methods.
  Conclusion: Discrete diffusion provides an effective alternative to autoregressive radiology report generation by enabling iterative, bidirectional report refinement. Incorporating clinically focused masking and image-derived concept conditioning improves report quality and clinical consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DRRG，一个基于离散扩散大语言模型的放射学报告生成框架，通过迭代去噪实现双向报告修正。
AI.motivation: 现有的自回归放射学报告生成方法逐字生成且无法修正先前内容，易产生错误传播且与实际的迭代报告过程不符，本文旨在利用离散扩散模型解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出DRRG框架，将报告生成转化为迭代掩码令牌去噪过程；引入临床实体感知互补掩码以提高监督覆盖率并强调重要实体，并通过概念条件模块将图像衍生的临床概念注入视觉表征。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR数据集上，尽管使用了更小的LLM解码器，DRRG在大多数指标上优于对比方法（BLEU-4为0.210，CheXbert-F1为0.549等）；在CheXpert Plus数据集上取得了最高的BLEU-4和CheXbert-F1。
AI.conclusion: 离散扩散通过实现迭代和双向的报告修正，为自回归放射学报告生成提供了有效替代方案；结合临床聚焦掩码和图像衍生概念条件化可提升报告质量与临床一致性。

title: Serving Masked Diffusion LLMs: Characterization and Design Principles from Real Hardware
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can in principle generate text faster than autoregressive (AR) models, since they denoise many tokens at once. Recent systems have begun building serving infrastructure for dLLMs, but none first measure how these models behave under real, concurrent serving load. Serving systems built without this grounding risk carrying over assumptions from AR serving that may not hold for dLLMs. We characterize dLLM serving to close this gap, using LLaDA-8B-Instruct with a D2F (Discrete Diffusion Forcing) LoRA adapter on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, evaluated on GSM8K and HumanEval. We report three findings. First, request difficulty, the number of denoising steps a request needs, is discrete rather than continuous: requests fall into 11 fixed step-count levels (178 + 29k), and no signal we test predicts the level before generation starts (best R2 = 0.150). Second, benchmarks with short generation budgets below 320 tokens understate serving variance, since requests are cut off before the latency spread appears. Third, only 24% of single-request wall-clock time is GPU computation; the rest is CPU-side dispatch overhead. Batching mainly helps by amortizing this overhead: sharing one forward pass per denoising step improves throughput by 16.0x at batch size 16 over a per-request-dispatch baseline. We also argue structurally that output quality should not degrade with batch size, stating three assumptions this rests on; we measure 74 to 76% GSM8K accuracy at single-request scale. Finally, we derive a batch-timeout rule for fixed-fill synchronized batching under Poisson arrivals. Together, these results show that serving diffusion language models needs parallelism at the level of each denoising step, which differs from AR serving in how admission and eviction interact with an already shared forward pass.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对掩码扩散语言模型在实际并发服务负载下的行为进行了表征，揭示了其与自回归模型服务的关键差异。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽然能比自回归模型更快生成文本，但现有服务系统缺乏对其在真实并发负载下行为的测量，可能导致错误地沿用AR模型的假设。
AI.method: 使用LLaDA-8B-Instruct配合D2F LoRA适配器，在单块NVIDIA H200 GPU上，针对GSM8K和HumanEval数据集进行系统化服务性能分析，并推导批处理超时规则。
AI.result: 请求难度呈离散分布（11个固定步数级别），无法提前预测；短token预算的基准测试低估了服务方差；单请求仅24%时间为GPU计算，批处理主要通过摊销CPU调度开销实现16.0倍吞吐提升；GSM8K准确率为74-76%。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型服务需要在每个去噪步骤层面进行并行化，其在准入和驱逐与已共享前向传播的交互方式上与AR服务有本质区别。

title: CAI-DLLM: Convergence Aware Inference for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models can generate many tokens in parallel, but they still require repeated denoising steps during inference. This makes generation costly, especially when the model continues to recompute tokens that are already stable. To address these limitations, we propose CAI-DLLM, a training-free inference method that uses first-step confidence to guide denoising and reduce inference time. Specifically, CAI-DLLM commits easy tokens earlier, allocates more denoising steps to harder tokens, and adjusts decoding schedules across output blocks. As it relies only on first-step confidence signals, it does not require retraining, extra predictors, or weight updates. We evaluate CAI-DLLM on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct across math, code, reasoning, commonsense, and long-context tasks. CAI-DLLM achieves up to 18.2x wall clock inference speedup on LLaDA GSM8K while improving accuracy from 76.27% to 77.41%, and up to 13.1x speedup on Dream HumanEval while achieving higher pass@1 than no-cache inference, 48.17% compared with 46.95%. On harder reasoning tasks, speedups reach 44.8x, with a largest accuracy drop of 4.4 points, while energy consumption is reduced by up to 95.3%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CAI-DLLM，一种无需训练的推理方法，通过首步置信度指导去噪，显著加速扩散语言模型的推理过程。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在推理时需要重复去噪步骤，导致生成成本高昂，尤其是模型会不断重新计算已经稳定的token。
AI.method: 提出CAI-DLLM，利用首步置信度信号指导去噪过程：提前提交简单token，将更多去噪步骤分配给困难token，并跨输出块调整解码计划。该方法无需重新训练、额外预测器或权重更新。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B等模型上的评估显示，CAI-DLLM在LLaDA GSM8K上实现了18.2倍的推理加速且准确率提升（76.27%至77.41%）；在Dream HumanEval上实现了13.1倍加速且pass@1提升（46.95%至48.17%）。在更困难的推理任务上加速达44.8倍（最大准确率下降4.4个点），能耗降低高达95.3%。
AI.conclusion: CAI-DLLM通过无需训练的置信度引导策略，在不牺牲（甚至提升）准确率的前提下大幅缩短了推理时间和降低了能耗。

title: Length-Adaptive Decoding for Masked Diffusion Machine Translation
summary: Machine translation tests masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) because every source token must be rendered faithfully, while fixed canvas decoding must choose target length before denoising. Existing masked diffusion decoding work mainly studies token unmasking order, leaving this length decision under-explored despite its direct effect on coverage and redundancy. We introduce Entropy-Valley (EV), a training-free length selector that scores candidate target canvases by mean predictive entropy from all-mask forward passes and selects the canvas the backbone is most prepared to fill. Relative to a baseline using training corpus length statistics, EV recovers 64.9%, 65.3%, and 33.0% of the COMET-22 gain from reference target lengths on En$\to$Zh, Zh$\to$En, and En$\to$De. Our diagnostics show that denoising-friendly lengths need not match reference lengths. Evaluation by three translation experts supports the En$\leftrightarrow$Zh adequacy gains, with stronger evidence on Zh$\to$En. Compared with a LLaMA-3-8B autoregressive (AR) model trained on the same fine-tuning data, the EV system ties on En$\to$Zh and leads on Zh$\to$En; an oracle-length diagnostic further shows that, in this masked diffusion MT setting, deciding which tokens to reveal first matters less than how the target length is supplied.
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, 7 figures. Code: https://github.com/Entropy-Valley/Entropy-Valley ; dataset and model: https://huggingface.co/collections/YanZhanPKU/entropy-valley

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的长度选择器Entropy-Valley（EV），通过预测熵优化掩码扩散语言模型在机器翻译中的目标长度决策。
AI.motivation: 在掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的机器翻译任务中，目标长度的选择直接影响翻译的覆盖率和冗余度，但现有研究多聚焦于去掩码顺序而忽略了长度决策问题。
AI.method: 提出Entropy-Valley（EV），一种无需训练的长度选择器。它通过全掩码前向传递计算候选目标画布的平均预测熵，从而选择模型最准备好填充的画布长度。
AI.result: 与基于语料库统计的基线相比，EV在En→Zh、Zh→En和En→De上分别恢复了64.9%、65.3%和33.0%的COMET-22增益。专家评估确认了En↔Zh的翻译充分性提升。对比LLaMA-3-8B自回归模型，EV在En→Zh上打平，在Zh→En上领先。诊断表明，去噪友好型长度无需匹配参考长度，且目标长度供应比token揭示顺序更重要。
AI.conclusion: 在掩码扩散机器翻译设置中，决定目标长度比决定去掩码顺序更为关键。EV作为一种简单有效的长度选择方法，能显著提升翻译质量并超越部分自回归模型。

title: CForce: Boosting Parallel Decoding for dLLMs via Consistency Forcing
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) accelerate language generation by predicting multiple masks in a single forward pass. However, existing dLLMs can suffer from unreliable predictions in early denoising stages under aggressive parallelism strategies, leading to errors that can propagate to later stages. To tackle this issue, we present Consistency Forcing (CForce) for dLLMs, a distillation method to force the mask predictions of early stages to align with those of later stages. CForce trains the model on pre-collected self-rollout trajectories, thereby improving training-inference alignment. We introduce Confidence Adaptive KL Divergence as a distillation objective to conjoin the merits of forward and reverse KL. We further provide a theoretical analysis for the consistency objective to explain why CForce can approximately minimize the prediction error of early stages. Critically, the same formulation applies to both mask-to-token decoding and edit-capable decoding; in the edit-capable case, later token-to-token refinements provide additional supervision for earlier masked-state predictions. Experiments on non-edit and edit-capable LLaDA models show improved speed-quality trade-offs, especially under high-parallelism decoding budgets. Code is available at: https://github.com/inclusionAI/dFactory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Consistency Forcing (CForce)方法，通过对齐扩散大语言模型早期和后期的掩码预测，解决了高并行策略下早期预测不可靠导致错误传播的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散大语言模型在激进并行策略下，早期去噪阶段的预测不可靠，导致错误传播到后续阶段，影响生成质量。
AI.method: 提出CForce蒸馏方法，在预收集的自展开轨迹上训练模型，强制早期掩码预测与后期对齐；引入置信度自适应KL散度作为蒸馏目标，结合正向和反向KL的优点，并适用于掩码到令牌及可编辑解码。
AI.result: 在非编辑和可编辑的LLaDA模型上实验表明，CForce改善了速度与质量的权衡，特别是在高并行解码预算下表现更佳。
AI.conclusion: CForce有效解决了dLLMs早期预测不可靠的问题，理论上近似最小化早期预测误差，未来可进一步扩展该方法的应用范围。

title: Ripple-Pivot Search: Active Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive language models, offering the potential for substantially faster inference through parallel decoding. Existing parallel decoding schedulers typically commit positions only after they meet a per-position criterion, overlooking how early commitments may benefit subsequent decoding. We identify a ripple effect in dLLM decoding: proactively committing a mid-entropy pivot position can induce a pronounced reduction in uncertainty across the remaining masked positions. This uncertainty reduction allows subsequent steps to unmask more tokens in parallel, thereby accelerating the overall decoding process. To exploit the ripple effect, we propose Ripple-Pivot Search (RPS), a novel training-free decoding method that seeks mid-entropy positions as promising candidate pivots (where to decode), and determines their token assignment that yields the greatest downstream benefit via lookahead evaluation (what to decode). Across 3 dLLMs and 4 reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, RPS achieves 4-10$\times$ wall-clock speedup over the standard decoder while preserving generation quality, and improves accuracy over the previous lookahead baseline by up to 5.49% while delivering higher throughput in most settings. When integrated with KV caching, RPS further achieves up to 18$\times$ wall-clock speedup over the standard decoder.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的解码方法RPS，通过利用中熵枢纽位置的涟漪效应来大幅加速扩散大语言模型的推理过程。
AI.motivation: 现有的并行解码调度器仅在满足基于位置的特定标准后才提交位置，忽略了提前提交对后续解码的潜在益处。
AI.method: 提出“涟漪枢纽搜索”（RPS），该方法寻找中等熵值的位置作为候选枢纽（决定在哪解码），并通过前瞻评估确定能产生最大下游收益的词元分配（决定解码什么）。
AI.result: 在3个dLLM和4个基准测试上，RPS在保持生成质量的同时，比标准解码器实现了4-10倍的挂钟时间加速；与先前的前瞻基线相比，准确率提高多达5.49%。结合KV缓存时，速度提升最高可达18倍。
AI.conclusion: RPS利用中熵枢纽的涟漪效应有效加速了dLLM解码，在不降低生成质量的前提下实现了显著的推理加速。

title: Continuous Interaction Diffusion: A Diffusion-Native Runtime for Asynchronous Tool-Augmented Reasoning
summary:
Large language models increasingly rely on external tools to access up-to-date information, perform computation, and interact with the outside world. For autoregressive models, tool use naturally fits the generation process: the model emits a tool call, waits for the result, and then continues generating. Diffusion language models (dLLMs), however, reason by repeatedly refining many parts of their output in parallel, making this stop-and-resume interaction pattern unnecessarily restrictive. It can force tool decisions before the model's reasoning has stabilized, delay useful observations until a discrete call finishes, and introduce redundant refinement and tool execution, potentially hurting both task accuracy and inference efficiency.
  We introduce Continuous Interaction Diffusion (CID), a diffusion-native model--runtime architecture that integrates tool interaction into iterative denoising. CID separates a model-read-only fact channel, a thought channel represented by a Typed Cognitive Tensor, and a display channel. Information needs can emerge before a textual or JSON call is fully serialized, allowing perceptual bindings to launch external reads while denoising continues. Returned results are projected into the evolving thought state and can revise earlier cognition and display regions. Persistent bindings reuse static results without repeated external execution and refresh changing sources when needed. CID is designed to expose evidence earlier, overlap tool latency with model computation, reduce duplicate external work, and preserve useful computation after new evidence arrives. We formalize the architecture, runtime, and training objectives, and define an evaluation protocol for task quality and end-to-end efficiency. This first paper focuses on read-only tools and makes no empirical performance claims.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Continuous Interaction Diffusion（CID）架构，将工具交互集成到扩散语言模型的迭代去噪过程中，而非采用传统自回归模型的停止-恢复模式。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通过并行精炼多个输出部分进行推理，而传统的自回归式工具调用模式（发出调用、等待结果、继续生成）在此场景下过于受限——它可能在模型推理稳定前就强制工具决策、延迟有用观测、并引入冗余的精炼与工具执行，损害任务准确性和推理效率。
AI.method: CID将工具交互嵌入迭代去噪过程，通过三个分离通道实现：只读事实通道、由Typed Cognitive Tensor表示的思维通道、以及显示通道。信息需求可在完整序列化文本或JSON调用之前出现，允许感知绑定在去噪继续的同时启动外部读取；返回结果被投影到演化的思维状态中，可修正先前的认知和显示区域；持久绑定可复用静态结果而无需重复外部执行，并在需要时刷新变化源。
AI.result: 本文形式化了架构、运行时和训练目标，并定义了任务质量和端到端效率的评估协议。本文是首篇论文，聚焦于只读工具，不包含经验性性能声明。
AI.conclusion: CID旨在更早暴露证据、将工具延迟与模型计算重叠、减少重复外部工作、并在新证据到达后保留有用计算，为扩散语言模型的原生工具交互提供了理论基础和评估框架。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting tokens and verifying them in parallel. Block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash model only per-position marginals, and tree methods such as DDTree expand candidate trees from those marginals. The released Domino drafter adds a GRU-based causal correction making each draft token's distribution path-dependent, a structure DDTree's factorized formulation cannot represent. We introduce DominoTree, a training-free best-first draft tree scored by Domino's conditional (non-factorized) correction along each root-to-node path, made practical by restricting the per-node correction to a candidate top-M. We evaluate it on eight benchmarks in a single-stream harness, and in SGLang, where it runs as an out-of-tree plugin against AR, DFlash, EAGLE-3 and Domino under identical flags. DominoTree attains the highest mean accepted length in every serving cell - two model sizes, single-request and concurrent load, context to 32K - and the highest Overall accepted length at every temperature in the research harness (21 of 24 per-dataset cells). A three-arm decomposition holding drafter, budget and verifier fixed separates the gain from applying the correction at all (+10.1% accepted length) from that of recomputing it along each candidate's realized path (+4.7% more), the part this paper adds. Where the round is verify-dominated, throughput follows: up to 7.3x over AR on Qwen3-8B, beating the released Domino decoder at its CUDA-graph best at every temperature, and inside SGLang winning single-request throughput by +12% over Domino on Qwen3-8B. On HELMET long context it beats Domino by +29-36% accepted length and +10-34% throughput at every length and both model sizes. Past a memory-constrained card's admission cap the chain wins goodput, and at our longest context, where prefill dominates, our lead over EAGLE-3 narrows to a tie.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DominoTree，一种无需训练的最佳优先草稿树构建方法，通过利用Domino的路径依赖条件校正，显著提升了LLM推理的接受长度和吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的树结构方法（如DDTree）采用因子分解公式，无法表示Domino草稿器中基于GRU的路径依赖因果校正分布。
AI.method: 提出DominoTree，一种无需训练的最佳优先草稿树，沿每个根到节点的路径利用Domino的条件（非因子分解）校正进行评分，并通过将每个节点的校正限制在候选top-M中来实现实用化。
AI.result: 在8个基准测试和SGLang中评估，在所有服务单元中获得了最高的平均接受长度；吞吐量最高比AR快7.3倍，在Qwen3-8B上比Domino的单请求吞吐量高12%；在HELMET长上下文基准中，接受长度比Domino高29-36%，吞吐量高10-34%。
AI.conclusion: DominoTree成功利用路径依赖校正重新计算草稿树路径得分，在多种设置下实现了卓越的性能，但在上下文极长且预填充占主导地位时，其相对于EAGLE-3的优势缩小至持平。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 GRAFT 框架，通过引入目标蒸馏边打分（TDES）和状态感知预算分配（SABA），优化了基于扩散语言模型（DLM）的推测解码中的草稿树构建，实现了显著的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于树的推测解码方法与扩散语言模型（DLM）草稿器不兼容，且现有适配方法（如 DDTree）在边选择上仅依赖 token 概率而忽略父子兼容性，同时固定预算未能根据解码状态动态调整，导致性能次优。
AI.method: GRAFT 框架包含两个核心技术：1) 目标蒸馏边打分（TDES），从目标模型轨迹中提取父子偏好以选择目标兼容的边；2) 状态感知预算分配（SABA），通过平衡预期草稿增益与验证成本来动态设置每轮树预算。
AI.result: 在多个模型和任务上，GRAFT 相比自回归解码实现了 2.13 倍至 6.36 倍的端到端加速，且每轮仅增加不到 0.5 毫秒的开销（约占目标模型验证延迟的 1.4%）。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT 有效解决了 DLM 草稿器在树构建中的父子兼容性与动态预算问题，以极低的额外开销实现了高效的推测解码，为基于 DLM 的加速推理提供了可行方案。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaDDTree，一种成本感知的扩散草稿树方法，通过联合优化树结构和节点预算来直接最大化token吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的DDTree方法在固定节点预算下最大化期望接受长度，但接受长度对预算是非递减的，总是偏向更大的树而忽略验证成本，缺乏预算选择的原则性依据。
AI.method: CaDDTree显式建模草稿和验证延迟，将吞吐量目标分解为每轮对预算的一维搜索，并证明在凸验证成本下吞吐量函数是单峰的，从而使用高效的贪心停止规则；无需离线预算搜索，每轮根据当前位置分布和验证成本自适应调整预算。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上跨越推理、编码和指令遵循等8个基准测试的实验表明，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上匹配或超越具有oracle预算选择的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree通过成本感知的树结构和预算联合优化，实现了无需离线搜索的自适应推理加速，在多种任务上达到了与oracle预算选择相当或更优的性能。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TAPS方法，通过目标感知的前缀选择解决扩散模型推测解码中的验证瓶颈，实现了最高7.9倍的无损端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 使用扩散模型进行并行起草虽能降低起草延迟，但将瓶颈转移到了验证阶段。现有方法基于边际概率排序节点，忽略了验证是前缀条件化的，导致验证不可达的节点并增加延迟。
AI.method: 提出TAPS（目标感知前缀选择）方法，将扩散边际概率转化为路径条件化的接受估计，并在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭包子树，从而优化接受率和验证成本的权衡。
AI.result: 实验表明，TAPS相比原始自回归解码实现了高达7.9倍的无损端到端加速，且性能分别优于当前最先进的DFlash和DDTree方法1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS有效解决了扩散起草中的验证瓶颈，在无损加速方面显著优于现有方法，为推测解码的草稿树验证提供了更高效的路径。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DDTree方法，通过从块扩散模型的逐位置分布构建草稿树，提升了推测解码的接受长度和整体性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的DFlash方法每轮仅验证单个草稿轨迹，限制了接受长度，本文旨在解决这一性能瓶颈。
AI.method: DDTree直接利用块扩散模型的逐位置分布构建草稿树，在固定节点预算下采用最佳优先堆算法选择最可能匹配目标模型的延续路径，并使用仅祖先的注意力掩码在单次前向传播中高效验证该树。
AI.result: 基于领先的DFlash模型，DDTree显著提升了推测解码性能，使其跻身最先进的推测解码方法之列。
AI.conclusion: DDTree成功克服了单轨迹验证的局限性，结合DFlash实现了更高效的推测解码，展示了块扩散模型在构建草稿树方面的潜力。

title: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs as Generalist Vision-Language-Action Agents for Drone Control: Commanding, Approaching, Tracking and Searching
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are strong perceivers of images and video. We ask how far that reach extends into acting: dropping an MLLM directly into a drone's control loop, with its entire action space declared solely in the prompt. Recent systems approach this setting but increasingly narrow the model's decision-making. We widen it back. We introduce DroneCATS-Agent, an architecture where the MLLM is a swappable component, and DroneCATS, a benchmark treating the model as the independent variable. Beyond merely flying toward a pixel, our agent entrusts the model to yaw and search, deliberate when unsure, and self-declare arrival---all without fine-tuning or function-calling schemas. Evaluating frontier and open models across four core capabilities---approaching a visible target, tracking a moving one, searching outside the initial view, and commanding a multi-drone fleet---reveals that even the simplest embodied settings are far from solved. Crucially, to identify what breaks first at the edge, our roster scales down to 2B parameters. The findings expose a stark paradox: it is not the flying that fails. Small open models often navigate into the success radius more reliably than frontier models, yet lose the episode by declaring arrival prematurely or not at all. Multi-drone commanding amplifies this divide, with small models failing by blindly copying a single coordinate across distinct views. Viewed as vision-language-action agents, the models' spatial perception holds up, but their action protocol does not. What separates a deployable edge model from a frontier model is not navigation, but the discipline to sustain a declared protocol and emit the correct terminating action. The open problem is closing this gap at onboard compute costs---yielding a fast model that plans persistently and knows exactly when it is done---and DroneCATS is built to measure that distance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DroneCATS-Agent架构和DroneCATS基准，评估多模态大语言模型作为无人机控制主体的能力，发现导航本身不是瓶颈，维持行动协议和正确终止才是关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM驱动的无人机系统逐渐缩窄模型决策空间，但缺乏对模型作为独立变量在端到端无人机控制中能力的系统性评估，特别是在边缘计算约束下小模型能否胜任复杂飞行任务。
AI.method: 提出DroneCATS-Agent架构，将MLLM作为可替换组件直接置入无人机控制回路，全部动作空间仅通过提示声明，无需微调或函数调用模式；同时提出DroneCATS基准，评估四项核心能力：接近可见目标、跟踪移动目标、视野外搜索、多机舰队指挥，模型规模下探至2B参数。
AI.result: 发现核心悖论：飞行本身并非失败点。小型开放模型在导航进入成功半径方面往往比前沿大模型更可靠，却因过早声明到达或完全不声明而失败。多机指挥放大了这一分化，小模型因盲目复制单一坐标跨不同视图而失败。模型的空间感知能力尚可，但行动协议执行不力。
AI.conclusion: 可部署边缘模型与前沿模型的区别不在于导航能力，而在于维持已声明协议并发出正确终止动作的纪律性。开放问题是在机载计算成本下弥合这一差距，获得能持久规划并准确判断任务完成的快速模型，DroneCATS正是为衡量该距离而构建。

title: Separating Syntax from Language: A Mechanistic Account of Translation in Multilingual LLMs
summary: Multilingual large language models (mLLMs) achieve strong performance in machine translation, yet our understanding of the mechanisms by which they transform representations from one language to another remains incomplete. Prior work suggests that translation decomposes into separable processes within an mLLM, where conceptual content is first represented independently, followed by a production into language-specific form. In this work, we show that translation is even more modular than previously assumed and that the output language production in translation processes is actually further separable into a syntax and a surface language process. We construct controlled multilingual datasets that isolate cross-linguistic differences in word-order and use causal interventions and probing to track how representations are transformed during translation. We find that models first construct target-side word-order before realizing the target language surface form. We identify individual attention heads that are selectively sensitive to syntactic transformations while remaining largely invariant to language identity. These results establish the commitment to a syntactic structure as an independent stage in translation, extending prior decompositions and showing how translation is implemented by functionally different components within mLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多语言大语言模型在机器翻译中的机制比以往认知的更加模块化，即输出语言产生过程可进一步分离为语法和表层语言过程。
AI.motivation: 尽管多语言大语言模型在机器翻译中表现优异，但对其如何将一种语言的表示转换为另一种语言的机制理解尚不完整，且先前对翻译过程的分解不够精细。
AI.method: 构建隔离词序跨语言差异的受控多语言数据集，并利用因果干预和探针技术追踪翻译过程中的表示转换。
AI.result: 实验发现模型在实现目标语言表层形式之前会先构建目标侧词序，并识别出特定的注意力头对语法转换敏感且对语言身份保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了对语法结构的承诺是翻译中的独立阶段，扩展了翻译过程分解理论，并证明了mLLMs通过功能不同的组件实现翻译。

title: S$^2$Prune: Spatially Structured Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Visual token pruning reduces the inference overhead of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by retaining only a subset of visual tokens. Existing methods usually select tokens based on importance or redundancy. However, we observe that these criteria produce stable spatial biases across inputs and do not always outperform simple Uniform Grid sampling, highlighting the value of broad spatial coverage. Motivated by this, we propose S$^2$Prune, a training-free pruning method that preserves spatial coverage while adapting token density to local image structure. We first divide the image into regions and assign at least one token to each region to preserve coverage. The remaining token budget is then distributed according to Laplacian variation, giving more tokens to regions with richer structure. We then use Early Representation Change (ERC), computed from the first decoder block, to select representative tokens within each region. We evaluate S$^2$Prune across diverse settings and two MLLM architectures. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, it achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated training-free pruning methods. With only 32 of the original 576 visual tokens, it still retains 79.3% of the full-model performance. Code is available at https://github.com/yuanyuanjia71-spec/S2Prune.
comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material. Code is available at https://github.com/yuanyuanjia71-spec/S2Prune

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为S²Prune的无训练视觉token剪枝方法，通过保持空间覆盖并适应局部图像结构来降低多模态大语言模型的推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于重要性或冗余度的token剪枝方法会产生稳定的空间偏差，且不总是优于简单的均匀网格采样，这表明广泛的空间覆盖对于token选择至关重要。
AI.method: S²Prune首先将图像划分为多个区域并为每个区域分配至少一个token以保持覆盖；剩余预算根据拉普拉斯变化分配给结构更丰富的区域；最后利用从第一个解码器块计算的早期表示变化（ERC）选择各区域内的代表性token。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型上，S²Prune在受评估的无训练剪枝方法中获得了最高平均准确率，且仅使用576个原始视觉token中的32个时，仍保留了79.3%的全模型性能。
AI.conclusion: S²Prune验证了在无训练视觉token剪枝中结合空间覆盖保持与局部结构自适应的有效性，提供了一种高效降低MLLM推理开销的解决方案。

title: Dotting the Eye: An Intent-Driven Image Retouching Agent for Visual Focus Enhancement
summary: Image retouching is commonly formulated as enhancing overall visual quality through color adjustment, but in practice, it also serves to emphasize visual focus by guiding viewers' attention toward a specific subject or region. Achieving such focus-oriented retouching is inherently challenging, as it requires well-coordinated global and local adjustments to manipulate perceptual saliency while maintaining visual naturalness. This intricate process typically demands substantial professional expertise. In this study, we propose EyeControl, a MLLM-driven agent with a diffusion-based retouching executor that enables visual focus enhancement under weak user intent. With only a few clicks or coarse strokes, EyeControl directs visual attention to the intended region, effectively "dotting the eye" of the image. The core idea is to explicitly link the weak user intention with the target editing region and the corresponding tonal adjustment operations during retouching. To achieve this, the system first interprets the intent and image content to infer the visual focus and generate structured intent guidance for the retouching executor. Second, the retouching executor is encouraged to respond more strongly to the target region, explicitly aligning its attention map with a designed pseudo-intent map. We also introduce an operation-consistency constraint to improve coordination between global and local adjustments, achieving more natural and coherent retouching. Additionally, we contribute ControlArt-Bench, a high-quality evaluation dataset for visual focus enhancement. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that EyeControl yields perceptually appealing results with stronger intent alignment. Code can be found in https://github.com/DragonisCV/EyeControl.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个由多模态大语言模型驱动的图像修饰智能体EyeControl，通过弱用户意图（如点击或粗略涂鸦）实现视觉焦点的增强。
AI.motivation: 以焦点为导向的图像修图需要协调全局与局部调整以操控感知显著性并保持自然感，这通常依赖大量专业知识。本文旨在解决在弱用户意图下如何实现专业级视觉焦点增强的挑战。
AI.method: 提出EyeControl系统，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）解释用户弱意图和图像内容，生成结构化意图指导。其基于扩散模型的修图执行器通过将注意力图与设计的伪意图图对齐来增强对目标区域的响应，并引入操作一致性约束以协调全局与局部调整。
AI.result: 广泛的评估表明，EyeControl能产生感知上令人愉悦且具有更强意图对齐的修图结果。此外，本文还贡献了高质量的视觉焦点增强评估数据集ControlArt-Bench。
AI.conclusion: EyeControl成功通过弱意图引导实现了视觉焦点增强，通过显式链接用户意图、编辑区域和色调调整操作，实现了更自然、连贯的图像修图。

title: On the Design Fundamentals of Pixel Text Representation Learning
summary: Text-rich visual inputs require models that can read, retrieve, and compress language directly in pixel space, yet existing pixel-text encoders struggle with fixed resolution pretraining, visual shortcut learning, weak visual grounding, and multilingual visual text understanding. In this work, we investigate the fundamental design principles required for robust visual text representation learning. Through systematic controlled ablations, we identify four critical components: variable image resolutions and rendered font sizes provide spatial proxies for high-resolution document generalization; natural image-text pairs are indispensable for grounding and prevent text-only collapse; layout-aware rendering helps prevent pixel-level shortcuts; and a two-stage multilingual curriculum enables effective cross-lingual alignment. By integrating these principles into a scalable training recipe, we train Pixel Linguist II, a native-resolution vision encoder trained with on-the-fly rendering, unified contrastive grounding, and a multilingual curriculum over 280M training examples. Pixel Linguist II sets new state-of-the-art results on English, cross-lingual, and multilingual Visual STS and ViDoRe, while also enabling better MLLM downstream evaluation. Notably, Pixel Linguist II remains robust under 80\% visual token compression, showing great promise for optical context compression. Our code and resources are available at https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Pixel Linguist II，通过整合四个关键设计原则，实现了鲁棒且最先进的视觉文本表征学习。
AI.motivation: 现有的像素-文本编码器在处理富文本视觉输入时，面临固定分辨率预训练、视觉捷径学习、视觉基础薄弱和多语言理解不足等问题。
AI.method: 通过系统性消融实验识别出四个关键设计原则：可变图像分辨率与渲染字体大小、自然图文对、布局感知渲染以及两阶段多语言课程；基于此训练了原生分辨率视觉编码器Pixel Linguist II。
AI.result: 该模型在英语、跨语言及多语言的Visual STS和ViDoRe基准上取得最新最优结果，并在80%视觉token压缩下保持鲁棒性，同时提升了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）下游任务表现。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的设计原则能够有效指导鲁棒视觉文本表征模型的训练，且模型在光学上下文压缩方面展现出巨大潜力。

title: Fi-ImageNet-1k: An OOD Benchmark From the Inside of the ImageNet-1k Validation Set
summary:
Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection predicts whether a test image belongs to none of the predefined classes. To evaluate this task, benchmarks need images from outside the in-distribution (ID) data; typically, these are defined or collected in an ad hoc fashion. Since no ground truth is perfect, ID-labeled datasets themselves contain a natural source of OOD images. We exploit such annotation errors and present Fi-ImageNet-1k, an OOD dataset built from ImageNet-1k validation images that the recent ReImageNet reannotation effort assigned to no ImageNet-1k class. Each image was examined by expert human annotators supported by evidence from MLLMs, VLMs, and reverse image search, comparing it against all visually similar ID classes. We keep only images that could be assigned a specific class outside the ImageNet-1k label space.
  The resulting Fi-ImageNet-1k, with 655 images from 522 classes, is substantially more challenging than any commonly used OOD dataset. No evaluated combination of classifier and OOD detector achieves a false positive rate below 51% at 95% true positive rate (FPR@95). Compared to the recent NINCO, our dataset is 3.8x more challenging in the FPR@95 metric for state-of-the-art supervised OOD detection methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于ImageNet-1k验证集标注错误构建的、极具挑战性的分布外（OOD）检测数据集Fi-ImageNet-1k。
AI.motivation: 现有的OOD基准数据集通常是临时收集的，且由于不存在完美的真实标签，分布内（ID）数据集本身自然包含由于标注错误产生的OOD图像。本文旨在利用这些标注错误来构建更自然的OOD评估基准。
AI.method: 利用ReImageNet重标注项目中未分配给任何ImageNet-1k类别的验证图像构建了Fi-ImageNet-1k数据集。通过专家人工标注，结合多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）、视觉语言模型（VLMs）和反向图像搜索提供的证据，与所有视觉相似的ID类别进行比较，仅保留可分配给ImageNet-1k标签空间之外特定类别的图像。
AI.result: 该数据集包含来自522个类别的655张图像，比常用的OOD数据集更具挑战性。在95%真阳性率下，没有任何分类器和OOD检测器组合能达到低于51%的假阳性率（FPR@95）。与最近的NINCO数据集相比，在最先进的监督OOD检测方法的FPR@95指标上，该数据集的挑战性高出3.8倍。
AI.conclusion: Fi-ImageNet-1k提供了一个基于自然标注错误的高难度OOD检测基准，凸显了当前OOD检测方法在处理细粒度、近分布OOD样本时的局限性。

title: SinkPruner: Sink-Free Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary:
Despite their strong multimodal understanding ability, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial computational overhead when processing long visual token sequences. To reduce inference costs, recent studies have explored visual token pruning through vision-centric or text-guided strategies. However, these methods often overlook high-norm outlier tokens, i.e., tokens with abnormally large feature norms, leading to suboptimal pruning decisions. In this work, we show that such high-norm outlier tokens are highly redundant in both feature and spatial dimensions, yet are often mistakenly preserved as informative cues by existing methods.
  Motivated by this observation, we propose SinkPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient MLLM inference. SinkPruner follows a coarse-to-fine design with two key modules: a visual sanitizer that filters high-norm redundancies and alleviates attention sink and attention dispersion, and a text-guided pruner that further retains tokens semantically aligned with the text query.
  Extensive experiments on twelve image-language and four video-language benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and generalizability of our framework. Notably, SinkPruner preserves 96.5% (91.8%) of the original performance of LLaVA-1.5 (Qwen2.5-VL) under an 89% token reduction. Experiments further indicate that our visual sanitizer exhibits promising transferability in enhancing the performance of existing pruning methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/LaVi-Lab/SinkPruner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SinkPruner，一种无需训练的视觉Token剪枝框架，通过过滤高范数异常冗余Token并结合文本引导剪枝，在大幅降低多模态大语言模型推理成本的同时保持高性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在处理长视觉Token序列时计算开销巨大，而现有的视觉Token剪枝方法忽略了高范数异常Token（实际上高度冗余），导致剪枝决策不佳。
AI.method: 提出SinkPruner框架，采用粗到细的设计，包含两个核心模块：视觉清理器（过滤高范数冗余Token，缓解注意力汇聚和注意力分散）和文本引导剪枝器（保留与文本查询语义对齐的Token）。
AI.result: 在12个图文和4个视频语言基准上的实验表明，该框架在减少89%Token的情况下，LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5-VL分别保留了96.5%和91.8%的原始性能；视觉清理器对现有剪枝方法也展现出良好的迁移增强效果。
AI.conclusion: SinkPruner在多模态大语言模型的高效推理方面具备有效性、高效性和泛化性，为解决长视觉Token序列带来的高昂计算成本提供了实用方案。

title: Forbid Your Attention: Fooling Multimodal Large Language Models by Selectively Removing Intrinsic Focus in Spectral Domain
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have extended the capability of large language models (LLMs) to process more contextual multimodal information, showing remarkable progress in diverse realistic multimodal applications. Despite their strong perception and reasoning abilities, recent studies reveal that MLLMs remain highly vulnerable to adversarial inputs, especially those targeting visual components. However, existing attacks mainly focus on global perturbations, lacking an understanding of how MLLMs internally interpret visual structures. In this paper, we make the attempt to investigate the intrinsic focus of MLLMs in the frequency domain and discover that their predictions are particularly sensitive to phase information, which encodes essential structural and semantic cues. Based on this observation, we propose a novel phase-aware adversarial attack framework that explicitly restricts adversarial perturbations to structure-relevant phase regions to suppress the MLLMs' focus for effective and imperceptible attacks. To further amplify the structural influence, we also introduce an auxiliary adversarial prompt learning module to guide multimodal misalignment around phase-sensitive regions, misleading the MLLM's attention toward targeted structural patterns. Extensive experiments on multiple representative MLLM models and datasets demonstrate the superior effectiveness of our method compared to existing attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种相位感知的对抗攻击框架，通过限制对结构相关相位区域的扰动并引入辅助对抗性提示学习，有效且隐蔽地攻击多模态大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的对抗性攻击主要集中于全局扰动，缺乏对模型内部如何解析视觉结构的理解，因此需要更有效且难以察觉的攻击方法来揭示该脆弱性。
AI.method: 基于MLLMs对频域相位信息高度敏感的发现，提出将对抗性扰动明确限制在与结构相关的相位区域；同时引入辅助对抗性提示学习模块，在相位敏感区域引导多模态错位以误导模型注意力。
AI.result: 在多个代表性MLLM模型和数据集上的实验表明，该方法相较于现有攻击具有更优越的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用频域相位信息并结合提示学习可以实现对MLLMs视觉组件的有效隐蔽攻击，揭示了模型对相位信息的敏感性，为未来攻防研究提供了新方向。

title: Same Semantics, Different Outcome: On the Modality Robustness of Multimodal LLMs under Knowledge Conflict
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly provided with contextual evidence in heterogeneous forms: as a text passage, as a rendered image of the same passage, or as both together. However, it remains unclear how consistently these surface forms are processed, especially when the evidence conflicts with the model's parametric knowledge. We study modality robustness under knowledge conflict across 13 MLLMs and two datasets, and find them far from robust. (1) Contrary to common belief, models favor a context that contradicts parametric knowledge more readily in image form than in text form; (2) when a contradicting text and image are presented together, the preferred modality is essentially arbitrary, varying with input order, model, and dataset. We further demonstrate that this instability has practical consequences: it degrades performance in multimodal RAG and can be exploited by adversarial attacks. To alleviate this brittleness, we examine several simple techniques---prompting, steering, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and direct preference optimization; the majority prove ineffective, whereas SFT achieves moderate success. We therefore call for greater awareness of this inconsistency and argue that it is fundamental, demanding attention at multiple training stages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多模态大语言模型在知识冲突下的模态鲁棒性，发现模型在处理不同模态的冲突证据时表现出严重的不稳定性，且多数缓解技术效果不佳。
AI.motivation: 当提供给多模态大语言模型的上下文证据与其内部参数化知识发生冲突时，模型在处理不同模态（文本、图像或两者结合）证据时的一致性和鲁棒性尚不明确，本文旨在探究并解决这一问题。
AI.method: 在两个数据集和13个多模态大语言模型上评估了知识冲突下的模态鲁棒性，并测试了提示、导向、监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化等缓解技术的效果。
AI.result: 研究发现模型缺乏鲁棒性：相比文本，模型更易接受与参数知识冲突的图像上下文；当冲突的文本和图像同时出现时，模型对模态的偏好具有任意性。这种不稳定性会降低多模态RAG性能并易受对抗性攻击。在缓解技术中，多数无效，仅SFT取得适度成功。
AI.conclusion: 模型在模态处理上的不一致性是一个根本性问题，需要在多个训练阶段予以关注，研究呼吁提高对该问题的认识。

title: Beyond Blind Compliance: Benchmarking Task Verification in OCR Reasoning
summary:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on OCR-centric document understanding and text-rich visual reasoning benchmarks. Yet existing evaluations largely assume that every task is valid and answerable. In real-world OCR scenarios, this assumption often fails: questions may rely on illegible text, occluded evidence, nonexistent visual targets, contradictory premises, or missing variables. We study this reliability gap as OCR-grounded Task Verification: before answering, a model should determine whether the Image Premise (IP), Textual Premise (TP), and Question (Q) jointly define an executable task.
  We introduce VeriOCRBench, a 1,800-sample human-verified benchmark built from source images drawn from 8 OCR-related datasets and spanning 8 real-world image domains, with controlled, image-grounded diagnostic tasks.
  It contains 1,600 trap-injected invalid tasks across 8 trap types and four verification dimensions---Visual, Contextual, Factual, and Logical---plus 200 trap-free controls for measuring over-refusal. Built with a Visual Atomic Fact (VAF)-anchored pipeline and full human auditing, VeriOCRBench enables decoupled evaluation of task verification, root-cause diagnosis, and over-refusal. Evaluating 15 leading MLLMs reveals persistent blind compliance, diagnosis failures, and prompt-induced over-refusal, exposing a critical reliability gap in current OCR reasoning systems.
  The code is available at: https://github.com/zy001122/Beyond-Blind-Compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VeriOCRBench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在回答前验证OCR任务有效性的能力，揭示了当前系统在可靠性方面的严重缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型在处理OCR任务时，往往盲目回答无效或无法解答的问题（如依赖模糊文本、矛盾前提等），这在真实场景中常导致失败。本文旨在解决这一可靠性差距，提出在回答前模型应判断图像前提、文本前提和问题是否共同定义了可执行任务。
AI.method: 作者提出了VeriOCRBench，一个包含1800个经人工验证样本的基准。该基准使用视觉原子事实（VAF）锚定流程构建，包含1600个涵盖8种陷阱类型和4个验证维度（视觉、上下文、事实、逻辑）的无效任务，以及200个无陷阱对照样本以衡量过度拒绝现象。
AI.result: 对15个领先的多模态大语言模型进行评估，结果显示存在持续的盲目顺从、根因诊断失败以及提示诱导的过度拒绝问题，暴露了当前OCR推理系统中严重的可靠性差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态大语言模型在OCR场景下缺乏稳健的任务验证能力，突显了未来在模型可靠性和推理系统改进方面的迫切需求。
